input.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import re, json, statistics, collections
pat = re.compile(r'^(?P<ts>\S+) (?P<level>[A-Z]+) user=(?P<user>\S+) route=(?P<route>\S+) code=(?P<code>\S+) latency=(?P<lat>\d+)ms msg="(?P<msg>.*)"$')
rows=[]; bad=[]
for i,line in enumerate(open('server.log'),1):
    line=line.rstrip('\n')
    m=pat.match(line)
    if not m: bad.append((i,line)); continue
    d=m.groupdict(); d['lat']=int(d['lat']); d['lineno']=i; rows.append(d)
print("total parsed",len(rows),"bad",len(bad))
print(bad[:5])
print("counts by level", collections.Counter(r['level'] for r in rows))
err=[r for r in rows if r['level']=='ERROR']
print("error_count",len(err))
print("top codes", collections.Counter(r['code'] for r in err).most_common(5))
co=[r['lat'] for r in rows if r['route']=='/api/checkout']
print("checkout n",len(co),"mean",sum(co)/len(co) if co else None)
to=[r for r in rows if 'timeout' in r['msg'].lower()]
print("timeout lines",len(to),"unique users",len(set(r['user'] for r in to)))
print("timeout msg variants", collections.Counter(r['msg'] for r in to).most_common(5))
fat=[r for r in rows if r['level']=='FATAL']
print("fatal n",len(fat),"first",fat[0]['ts'] if fat else None, "file order min ts", min(r['ts'] for r in fat) if fat else None)
print("first fatal lineno", fat[0]['lineno'] if fat else None)
print("routes", collections.Counter(r['route'] for r in rows).most_common())
print("users sample", collections.Counter(r['user'] for r in rows).most_common(3))
EOF

input.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import re, collections
pat = re.compile(r'^(\S+) ([A-Z]+) user=(\S+) route=(\S+) code=(\S+) latency=(\d+)ms msg="(.*)"$')
rows=[]
for line in open('server.log'):
    m=pat.match(line.rstrip('\n')); rows.append(m.groups())
print("distinct users overall", len(set(r[2] for r in rows)))
print("distinct users on timeout", len(set(r[2] for r in rows if 'timeout' in r[6])))
print("distinct users on Timeout case-insens", len(set(r[2] for r in rows if 'timeout' in r[6].lower())))
ts=[r[0] for r in rows]
print("monotonic ts?", ts==sorted(ts), "dupes", len(ts)-len(set(ts)))
print("first 3 ts", ts[:3], "last", ts[-1])
print("codes overall", collections.Counter(r[4] for r in rows).most_common(8))
print("ERROR codes all", collections.Counter(r[4] for r in rows if r[1]=='ERROR').most_common())
print("fatal first 3", [ (i,r[0]) for i,r in enumerate(rows,1) if r[1]=='FATAL'][:3])
co=[int(r[5]) for r in rows if r[3]=='/api/checkout']
print("checkout n",len(co),"mean",sum(co)/len(co),"rounded",round(sum(co)/len(co)))
import statistics; print("median", statistics.median(co), "min/max", min(co),max(co))
EOF

cd /tmp/opencode/bench/log-analysis-baseline && python3 - <<'EOF'
import re, json, collections
pat = re.compile(r'^(\S+) ([A-Z]+) user=(\S+) route=(\S+) code=(\S+) latency=(\d+)ms msg="(.*)"$')
rows=[pat.match(l.rstrip('\n')).groups() for l in open('server.log')]
users=set(r[2] for r in rows)
print(sorted(users)[:5], sorted(users)[-3:], len(users))
print("non U-format users:", [u for u in users if not re.fullmatch(r'U\d+', u)])
ans={
 "error_count": sum(1 for r in rows if r[1]=='ERROR'),
 "top_error_code": collections.Counter(r[4] for r in rows if r[1]=='ERROR').most_common(1)[0][0],
 "checkout_mean_latency_ms": round(sum(int(r[5]) for r in rows if r[3]=='/api/checkout')/sum(1 for r in rows if r[3]=='/api/checkout')),
 "timeout_unique_users": len({r[2] for r in rows if 'timeout' in r[6]}),
 "first_fatal_ts": next(r[0] for r in rows if r[1]=='FATAL'),
}
json.dump(ans, open('answers.json','w'), indent=2)
print(json.dumps(ans, indent=2))
EOF
cat answers.json
